description: Runs a short ordered chain of existing apished operations in one call (same as POST /v1/pipe/run), passing one named field of each step's result into the next step's args. Stops at the first failing step.

args.description: that operation's normal JSON request body

from.description: carries one field of the previous step's result into this step's args

as.description: field name to set it as in this step's args

field.description: field name to read from the previous step's result

path.description: canonical REST path of the operation, e.g. /v1/hash/digest

name: pipe_run
